By way of the present petition filed under Articles 226/227 of the Constitution of India read with section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita 2023, the petitioners seek quashing of the case FIR No.413/2024 dated 29.06.2024 registered under sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 at P.S.: Jagat Puri, Delhi.
Chargesheet has been filed a long time ago.
In view thereof, before proceeding further with the matter, let the chargesheet filed by the Investigating Officer be placed on record before the next date.
